Text: God of infinite mercy, in the midst of our Easter celebrations, Your presence is reviving the faith of Your people. [t] Abundantly lavish Your grace upon us. [*] Let understanding take root in the hearts of all, that You have washed us clean from the stain of sin. We are being reborn by your Spirit, and by His blood we have been redeemed
